newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thais set up fund for farmers hit by disasters.
newsitem.headline: Thais set up fund for farmers hit by disasters.

text.p: Thailand approved the setting up of a three-billion-baht ($120 million) fund to help farmers whose crops might be affected by natural disasters, a government official said on Friday.
Farmers wishing to be recipients of the fund must contribute partly to it, an official at the state-run Bank for Agriculture and Agricultural Cooperatives told Reuters.
The government and the Bank for Agriculture would contribute 75 percent of the fund and farmers the remainder.
The proposal was made after devastating floods ravaged the country last year and wiped out many crops, the official said.
